subject: Intro: Veridian Health — per-1M token IO pricing & commit/packaging questions
messages:
From: Jack Liu <jack.liu@veridianhealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@veridianhealth.com, Sasha Reynolds <sasha.reynolds@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: baseline per-1M token IO rates + supported models (RFP attached)

Hi Michael,

We're evaluating Redwood for a multi-workload deployment (clinical summarization + patient Q&A). Procurement asked me to collect a baseline hosted pricing sheet so they can include it in our RFP. Specifically we need: 

- Per-1M token rates broken out by input vs output for hosted API (preferred format: input rate / output rate)
- A short list of supported model families you would recommend for low-latency (<=300ms tail p95) vs quality-first use cases
- Typical enterprise discount bands for a 12-month committed contract (examples: 6mo vs 12mo and volume thresholds)
- Notes on packaging: sandbox vs production separation, whether dedicated capacity is required for data isolation, and any add-on fees (SLA, longer retention of logs, SOC2 evidence delivery)

Attached is our RFP excerpt (Veridian_RFP.pdf). Can you send a baseline per-1M token sheet and any starter commit options your team typically proposes? We're hoping to compile vendor responses by next Wednesday.

Thanks,
Jack Liu
Director, Digital Platforms
Veridian Health
[Attachment: Veridian_RFP.pdf (pdf)]

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Jack Liu <jack.liu@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: baseline per-1M token IO rates + supported models (RFP attached)

Hi Jack — thanks for the RFP excerpt and the clear list. High-level answers below to get you moving; Ben and Marissa are cc'd and will jump in with a starter commit sheet and packaging options. If helpful we can also join a 30-min call to align on usage profile and SLAs.

Baseline hosted per-1M token (input / output) — public starter list (no commit):
- Redwood-1 Small family (suitable for low-cost, high-throughput inference): $0.80 / $1.60 per 1M tokens
- Redwood-2 Standard family (balanced latency/quality): $2.50 / $5.00 per 1M tokens
- Large quality models (e.g., Llama-2-13B class): $6.00 / $12.00 per 1M tokens

Notes on IO split: we charge separately for input and output tokens because generation cost scales with output length and compute. For many summarization flows the output is 1/4 to 1/2 the size of the input; we can model expected unit economics if you share average input/output lengths and expected QPS.

Recommended models for your two buckets:
- Low-latency (p95 <= 300ms): Redwood-1 small variants (quantized), optimized for short prompts and prefix caching.
- Quality-first: Redwood-2 Standard family or a tuned Llama-2-13B variant; recommend Redwood-2 for a good balance of quality and throughput unless you need extreme instruction-following fidelity.

Enterprise discounts and commitments (illustrative):
- 1–5M tokens/mo: public starter pricing (no discount)
- 5–50M tokens/mo: typical committed discount 15–25% on public rates for 12-month term
- 50M+ tokens/mo: 25–40% (tiered by committed volume and whether you include Dedicated capacity)

Packaging & isolation notes:
- Sandbox vs Prod: Sandbox is included for evaluation; production workloads should be run in a dedicated project for telemetry separation.
- Data isolation: Hosted + dedicated capacity options available. For regulated data we recommend Redwood Dedicated or Private deployment (VPC). Dedicated (reserved) provides logical isolation + SLA; Private provides customer-managed network.
- Add-ons: SLA-backed latency/uptime, extended log retention, and SOC 2/ISO evidence are available as paid add-ons or part of enterprise packages.

I've attached a short baseline sheet for the RFP. Ben will follow up with a proposed starter commit tier and an example price for a 12-month commitment so you can include it in procurement.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
[Attachment: Redwood_Hosted_Baseline_1M_IO_Sheet.pdf (pdf)]

Subject: Re: Request: baseline per-1M token IO rates + supported models (RFP attached)

Jack — adding a concrete starter commit proposal you can drop into procurement. These are starter examples; we can tailor discounts and commit levels if you share a 12-month forecast.

Starter 12-month commit examples (effective per-1M token input/output after commit):
- Pilot (commit: 5M tokens/mo): Redwood-1 Small: $0.68 / $1.36; Redwood-2 Std: $2.12 / $4.25; Llama-2-13B class: $5.10 / $10.20
- Growth (commit: 25M tokens/mo): Redwood-1 Small: $0.60 / $1.20; Redwood-2 Std: $1.95 / $3.90; Llama-2-13B class: $4.40 / $8.80
- Enterprise (commit: 100M tokens/mo): Redwood-1 Small: $0.48 / $0.96; Redwood-2 Std: $1.75 / $3.50; Llama-2-13B class: $3.60 / $7.20

Packaging & operational notes:
- Sandbox environment: included for dev + 30 days of logs; extended retention available as an add-on.
- Production separation: we recommend separate projects with role-based access; Dedicated pools can be reserved for production to ensure capacity and lower tail latency.
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II reports and SOC artifacts are provided under NDA; Private deployments available for air-gapped requirements.

I'll attach a starter XLSX with the math so procurement can see annualized spend and unit economics. If you want to move quickly, grab a 30-min slot here and we'll run a bespoke model with your monthly token profile: https://calendly.com/redwood-sales/30min?month=2027-05

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter

ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0147
